subTitle: Clear answers before we start working together.

faqs.question: What services does ColorSpire Creations offer?
faqs.answer: We provide graphic design, branding and brand identity, website design and development, social media content, social media management, digital marketing, photography, video editing and other creative digital solutions.

faqs.question: How do I start a project with ColorSpire?
faqs.answer: Start by telling us what you need, what you are trying to achieve and any deadline or reference you already have. We review the brief, clarify the scope and then recommend the best next step.

faqs.question: Do you work with businesses outside Zambia?
faqs.answer: Yes. ColorSpire is Zambia-based and can work with clients beyond Zambia through remote collaboration. Project scope, communication and delivery are agreed before work begins.

faqs.question: Can you handle both branding and the website?
faqs.answer: Yes. Combining brand identity and website development can create a more consistent digital presence because the visual language, content and user experience can be planned together.

faqs.question: How long does a website project take?
faqs.answer: Timelines depend on page count, content readiness, functionality, revisions and integrations. A project timeline should be confirmed after the scope is reviewed.

faqs.question: Can I request only one design or service?
faqs.answer: Yes. ColorSpire can support one-off creative needs as well as broader projects and ongoing creative support.

faqs.question: How do I request a quote?
faqs.answer: Use the Contact page or Start a Project CTA and provide the service you need, your goals, required deliverables, deadline and any useful references.

faqs.question: Can ColorSpire manage my social media content?
faqs.answer: Yes. Social media content creation and page management can be provided as standalone services or as part of a broader digital presence strategy.

faqs.question: Do you build custom websites or use templates?
faqs.answer: The implementation approach depends on the project. The priority is delivering a professional, responsive and maintainable website that fits the requirements.

faqs.question: What information should I prepare before contacting you?
faqs.answer: Useful information includes your business name, services, target audience, project goal, preferred pages/deliverables, deadline, existing brand assets and any references you like.
